After collect operations, the sum of balances never exceeds the total deposited ether in the reference, but the buggy version allows balances to exceed deposits.

After a successful collect by any user, the sum of all mapped balances must equal the contract's total deposits minus successful withdrawals; the buggy version lets balances get out of sync because deposits never increase balances, so after a collect the sum of balances will be less than deposits minus withdrawals.

After a successful collect by a user who previously deposited, the user's balance plus the ether sent during collect must be at least the original deposit; the buggy version ignores deposits so a collect after a deposit will revert instead of sending ether.

For any actor who deposits and then collects, the contract's ether balance after collection must equal the total deposits minus the amount collected; the buggy version never updates balances, so a collect succeeds without reducing the user's mapping, allowing more ether to be withdrawn than was deposited by that user.
